name: Nether Earth: mainmenu
summary: The main menu, the tape save and load of a game, the redefine-keys screen.

entries.name: MainMenu
entries.summary: The main menu: clear the screen, the title, the options; Z = start a new game, NZ = a game was loaded

entries.name: MainMenuTitle
entries.summary: The main menu without the clearing: the title, then the options

entries.name: MainMenuOptions
entries.summary: The main menu's options (re-entered after keys 1-3)

entries.name: MenuKeyboardOption
entries.summary: Option 1, KEYBOARD, in the colour of Controls 1

entries.name: MenuKempstonOption
entries.summary: Option 2, KEMPSTON J/S, in the colour of Controls 2

entries.name: MenuInterface2Option
entries.summary: Option 3, INTERFACE 2, in the colour of Controls 3; then options 4 and 5

entries.name: MainMenuKeys
entries.summary: The main menu's keys: the title music until a key, then 0-5

entries.name: PrintTitle
entries.summary: "NETHER" and "EARTH" in big white letters at the top

entries.name: PrintTitleEnd
entries.summary: PrintTitle's return; then the load option

entries.name: LoadGameBlocks
entries.summary: Load a saved game: the checksum block, the game block; NZ when it is good

entries.name: LoadError
entries.summary: After LOADING ERROR!: a beep, a key, then the start again (Start)

entries.name: SaveGame
entries.summary: Save the game to tape: the prompt, a key, the checksum block and the game block

entries.name: SaveGameBlocks
entries.summary: After the prompt: a key, the staging, the checksum, the two blocks

entries.name: SaveChecksum
entries.summary: DE = the 16-bit sum of the $24D1 bytes at $D92B (the saved game block)

entries.name: WaitAnyKey
entries.summary: Wait until no key is held, then until one is (all half rows of port $FE)

entries.name: ControlsOptionAttr
entries.summary: The attribute for menu option C: cyan ($45) when it is the current Controls, else yellow ($46)

entries.name: ControlsOptionPlain
entries.summary: ControlsOptionAttr's return, the option not chosen

entries.name: ControlsOptionChosen
entries.summary: ControlsOptionAttr's return, the option chosen

entries.name: RedefineKeys
entries.summary: Redefine the eight keys: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, FIRE, PAUSE, ABORT, SAVE

entries.name: RedefineKeysBody
entries.summary: Wait for no key, clear KeyTable, ask for UP

entries.name: ReadUpKey
entries.summary: The key for UP (KeyTable record 4), then ask for DOWN

entries.name: ReadDownKey
entries.summary: The key for DOWN (record 5), then ask for LEFT

entries.name: ReadLeftKey
entries.summary: The key for LEFT (record 6), then ask for RIGHT

entries.name: ReadRightKey
entries.summary: The key for RIGHT (record 7), then ask for FIRE

entries.name: ReadFireKey
entries.summary: The key for FIRE (record 3), a blank line, then ask for PAUSE

entries.name: ReadPauseKey
entries.summary: The key for PAUSE (record 0), then ask for ABORT

entries.name: ReadAbortKey
entries.summary: The key for ABORT (record 1), then ask for SAVE

entries.name: ReadSaveKey
entries.summary: The key for SAVE (record 2), wait for its release and a pause, back to the menu

entries.name: PrintKeyPrompt
entries.summary: "PRESS KEY FOR " and then the key's name that follows the caller's CALL

entries.name: PrintKeyPromptName
entries.summary: print the caller's inline key name and return past it

entries.name: DefineKey
entries.summary: wait for a free key, store its port, mask and code into a KeyTable entry, print its name

entries.name: DefineKeyScan
entries.summary: wait for a key that no entry holds yet

entries.name: KeyNameSymShiftEnd
entries.summary: a RET ($C9): PrintInline returns here and the routine ends

entries.name: CheckEnterKey
entries.summary: DefineKey: is the new key ENTER?

entries.name: KeyNameEnterEnd
entries.summary: a RET ($C9) after the string

entries.name: CheckCapsShiftKey
entries.summary: DefineKey: is the new key CAPS SHIFT?

entries.name: KeyNameCapsShiftEnd
entries.summary: a RET ($C9) after the string

entries.name: CheckSpaceKey
entries.summary: DefineKey: SPACE prints its name, any other key prints its own character

entries.name: DefineKeyDone
entries.summary: RET: the end of DefineKey; also the target of the music's command 0

labels.comment: the menu starts on an empty black screen

labels.name: MenuStartText
labels.comment: "0..START GAME" at (11,8) in double height, yellow
size 0 again for the options after it, then the end
cyan if it is the current choice, else yellow
three rows down, (14,8): "1..KEYBOARD", in the attribute ControlsOptionAttr just set
INTERFACE 2, then options 4 and 5 in yellow

labels.name: MenuMoreText
labels.comment: "3..INTERFACE 2", then in yellow "4..REDEFINE KEYS", "5..LOAD SAVED GAME"
wait until no key is held
the title's colours, also while keys are still held
ROM KEY-SCAN: E = the key value, $FF none
a key still held (from the last choice): wait
the title music, until a key

labels.name: MenuWaitKey
labels.comment: back from MenuMusic: a number key is down; one frame
the key's character from the ROM's main key table
$0205 + E (no carry: E is at most $27)
any other key: ignored, wait again
4: redefine the keys, then the whole menu again
the whole menu again (clear, title, options, keys)
Z: Start goes on into NewGameSetup ($A62D)
reprint the options in the new colours, then the keys (MenuMusic restarts)

labels.name: TitleText
labels.comment: "NETHER" at (1,10) and "EARTH" at (5,11), attribute $47, setting $32 (triple height, double width)
"NETHER" at (1,10) in $47 (white), size $32: double width, three rows high
back to the caller after the title text

labels.name: LoadGame
labels.comment: key 5: the title again, PRESS PLAY ON TAPE
the prompt, then on into the load

labels.name: PlayTapeText
labels.comment: "PRESS PLAY ON TAPE" at (22,7), cyan, double height
AT (22,7) in $45 (cyan), tall: LOAD SAVED GAME (key 5)
INC D / DEC D with the flags saved between: NZ in AF' as LD-BYTES wants
ROM LD-BYTES past its border set-up and the SA/LD-RET push; its error carry is not looked at
ROM LD-BYTES: the robots, the map, the variables, the staged shots and buildings
clear the carry for the SBC
HL = the saved sum - the sum of the loaded block
good: the staged tables back to their places
NZ: Start skips the new game set-up and goes to EnterPlay
the whole start-up again, then the menu
the start-up's handler: the play handler's work stops

labels.name: RecordText
labels.comment: "PRESS RECORD AND PLAY ", a new line, "     THEN ANY KEY     " at (22,0), cyan
"PRESS RECORD AND PLAY " at (22,0) in $45 (cyan): the save key (Input bit 5)
the next row (23,0): "     THEN ANY KEY     "
the player starts the tape and presses a key
the radar map is rebuilt afterwards
RadarDirty: the staging below overwrites the tail of RadarEnemy
stage the 5 records of 9 bytes at $D7D3 ...
Buildings -> SaveBuildings: $D92B-$FDFB is now the whole game
no interrupts while the tape runs
the sum at $5B00, the first tape block
carry set as for the ROM's own callers; this entry does not use it
ROM SA-BYTES past its pilot choice: HL = the pilot, A = the flag
interrupts back on (the caller then redraws the play screen)
E = the low byte of the sum
the carry into the high byte

labels.name: ChecksumNext
labels.comment: carry added into D; the next byte
IN with address $00FE: every half row
bits 0-4: the five keys of each half row
attribute $46 (yellow): a control option not chosen
back to the option, which prints its text next
a blank screen for the redefine screen
the heading and the first print position

labels.name: RedefineTitleText
labels.comment: "REDEFINE KEYS" at (2,9), white, double height, then position (5,3) and normal size
then AT (5,3) and size 0: the first PRESS KEY FOR line goes two rows below
wait until no key is held
key 4 is still held: wait for its release
DE = HL + 1: the LDIR spreads the 0
23 more bytes: the whole table, 8 records of 3
KeyTable all 0: no key is taken yet
"PRESS KEY FOR" and the name below
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: UP (Input bit 3, KeyTable record 4)
HL = the code byte of record 4 (Input bit 3, UP)
wait for a free key, fill the record, print its name
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: DOWN (Input bit 2, KeyTable record 5)
wait for the DOWN key, fill record 5, print its name
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: LEFT (Input bit 1, KeyTable record 6)
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: RIGHT (Input bit 0, KeyTable record 7)
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: FIRE (Input bit 4, KeyTable record 3)
a blank row between the moves and the game keys
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: PAUSE (Input bit 7, KeyTable record 0)
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: ABORT (Input bit 6, KeyTable record 1)
the action's name after PRESS KEY FOR: SAVE (Input bit 5, KeyTable record 2)

labels.name: RedefineWaitRelease
labels.comment: until the SAVE key is let go
the last key still held: wait
all keys up: a fixed pause of 65536 turns of the loop below (about 2 million T, 0.56 s) before the menu

labels.name: RedefineKeysPause
labels.comment: count BC down from $0000 through all 65536 values

labels.name: RedefineKeysPauseNop
labels.comment: a pad (the label is a false entry of the static walk: the string bytes before it read as JR NZ,$C406)
back to the caller of $C34A, which restarts the main menu ($C1CE)

labels.name: PressKeyForText
labels.comment: PrintInline text: new line, new line, attribute $46, "PRESS KEY FOR ", attribute $45
two rows down, attribute $46 (yellow): "PRESS KEY FOR "
attribute $45 (cyan) for the action's name that follows the CALL
the caller's string, and back past it
two spaces, then the attribute of the name
two spaces after the name, then $46 (yellow) for the key chosen

labels.name: DefineKeyWait
labels.comment: ROM KEY-SCAN: E = the key value, $FF none
the ROM's key table: E -> the key's code
$0205 + E (CAPS SHIFT alone, E = $27, reads $E3 just past the table)
L = $05 + E (no carry: E is at most $27)
A = the key's code (a character, $0D ENTER, $0E SYM SHIFT, $20 SPACE, $E3 CAPS SHIFT)
the code bytes of the eight entries

labels.name: KeyTakenLoop
labels.comment: a code already used is refused: wait again
this code is taken: refused, scan again (the entry address stays pushed)
C = the row index (0 = port $7FFE ... 7 = port $FEFE)
E / 2: three shifts make E / 8, the key's place in its half-row from bit 4 down
the mask: $20 rotated right E/8 + 1 times

labels.name: KeyMaskShift
labels.comment: one place right: bit 4 - E/8 is the key's bit
B rotations: $10 for E/8 = 0 ... $01 for E/8 = 4
the port high byte: row + 1 RRAs of $FF with the carry clear, the 0 walking right ($7F row 0 ... $FE row 7)
A = $FF; DEC leaves the carry clear

labels.name: KeyPortShift
labels.comment: the one 0 bit walks right ($7F, $BF ... $FE), ones come in from the carry
store the port high byte: the record is complete
its name, and the RET after the string
the name of key code $0E: SYMBOL SHIFT (the default KeyTable has $82 there)
its name, and the RET after the string
the name of key code $0D: ENTER
its name, and the RET after the string
the name of key code $E3: CAPS SHIFT (the byte past the ROM key table)
any other key: print its code as a character and return
the name of key code $20: SPACE
the end of DefineKey for SPACE
